qualification: Pre-fix Avi::parse accepted duplicate avih chunks in hdrl, duplicate strh/strf chunks in strl, and partial trailing entries in idx1, while AviAudioReader::seek_to returned 0 instead of dwStart (100) when seeking before the start of a delayed-start PCM stream.

2 focused tests, 3 related container audio integration tests, 34 AVI unit tests, 359 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture unittest, and full binary build pass.

Microsoft AVI RIFF File Reference governs singleton avih/strh/strf headers, 16-byte AVIOLDINDEX entries, and dwStart stream origin. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
